descriptions.preferred: This striking American cultivar has almost ribbonlike lobes and red coloration comparable with burgundy wine. The leaves are deeply divided with the seven lobes separated virtually to the leaf base. The lobes hold closely together, making the leaf appear longer than broad. The leaves are 6-10 cm long and 8-9 cm wide. Each lobe is ovate-lanceolate, coming to a very gradual sharp point. The lobes are up to 1.5 cm wide in the middle and narrow to a tiny 1 mm at the base. They are sharply toothed along the entire margin. Spring and early summer coloration is the typical burgundy red, but as the season progresses it turns bronzy or greenish. It burns in full sun. This spreading, small tree, up to 6 m high and wide, develops a wide canopy when given room. Although upright, it is classed in the smaller tree group. Hardy and beautiful, it makes an excellent contrast with other upright cultivars. It fits into smaller landscape plantings with judicious pruning. some short, some long, and most of them irregularly shaped on leaves of older wood. The leaves on new growth have lobes which are more uniform. The slender lobes are long and narrow, 2-5 cm long and 5-10 mm wide, and are separated almost to the leaf base. The petioles are short, 1-3 cm. The variegation is basically a cream or whitish color on a bluish to grayish green or pale green. Sometimes an entire leaf is cream colored, but most often this color appears on the edges of lobes or an entire lobe. Quite often the cream portion of the lobe is sickle shaped. Noticeable in the spring are the light pink markings which border the white or cream portions. In fall coloration, the white areas become a striking magenta, lending an entirely new quality to the appearance. Growth is normally short and twiggy, making a dense, large shrub or very small tree of 5-6 m high. It is stiffly upright. Occasionally, a plant in very good culture puts out a shoot 40-60 cm long. sources.title: 勃艮第蕾丝Acer palmatum 'Burgundy Lace'
sources.description: 三季红蕾丝叶品种，春天叶色呈现出勃艮第葡萄酒色， 夏季适当返绿，秋季红色。一般呈现 7 裂叶，叶裂至 基部，叶边缘的锯齿锋利。生长缓慢，树型较小，成 年树高不会超过 2 至 3 米，适合花园种植。勃艮第蕾 丝很耐寒，抗性强，如果春天出现霜冻或冷风，嫩叶 可能会枯死，但随后几周内植物就会长出新叶。获得 英国皇家园艺协会（RHS）奖。

rhs.description: A medium-sized deciduous shrub of spreading growth. Leaves light red-purple in spring, later deeper, divided to base into seven narrow, strongly toothed lobes

attributes.suggested_uses: Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in well-drained soil that does not dry out. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour best in partial shade, although they will tolerate full sun. Leaf scorch is caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个十分醒目的美国品种，裂片几乎呈带状，叶色可与勃艮第红葡萄酒相媲美。叶片深裂，7 枚裂片几乎一直分裂到叶基。各裂片彼此贴近，使整叶看起来较长而不宽。叶片长 6 至 10 厘米，宽 8 至 9 厘米。每枚裂片为卵状披针形，逐渐渐尖成锐尖端；中部宽可达 1.5 厘米，而基部最窄仅约 1 毫米。全缘均具尖锐锯齿。春季和初夏叶色为典型的勃艮第红，随着季节推进会转为带青铜色或略带绿色。在全日照下容易灼伤。植株开展，为小型乔木，高、宽均可达 6 米；空间充足时可形成宽阔树冠。虽为直立生长，但通常归入小型乔木类。该品种既耐寒又美观，与其他直立型品种形成良好对比；经适当修剪后，也适合较小尺度的景观种植。老枝上的叶片裂片长短不一，多数形状不规则；新梢叶片的裂片则较为整齐一致。细长裂片长 2 至 5 厘米、宽 5 至 10 毫米，几乎一直分裂到叶基。叶柄较短，长 1 至 3 厘米。斑锦基本为乳白色或白色，着生在带蓝绿色、灰绿色或浅绿色的叶面上。有时整片叶几乎为乳白色，但更常见的是裂片边缘或某一整枚裂片呈此色。乳白色部分常呈镰刀状。春季尤为明显的是围绕白色或乳白部分边缘的浅粉色斑纹。秋季变色时，白色区域会转为醒目的洋红色，使整体观赏效果更具特色。植株通常枝条短而密，形成致密的大型灌木或极小型乔木，高约 5 至 6 米，姿态较为硬挺直立。若栽培条件极佳，偶尔可抽生 40 至 60 厘米长的新梢。新梢和小枝都非常纤细柔弱。该品种嫁接较困难；与

care.cultivation: 宜种植于排水良好且不易干燥的土壤中。夏季必要时应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。叶缘焦枯通常由土壤缺水或暴晒过度引起。

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小的落叶灌木，株形开展。春季叶色为浅红紫色，随后颜色加深；叶片分裂至基部，形成 7 枚狭窄且具明显强锯齿的裂片。
